insights.title: Low-complexity regime-aware mutation patterns for drawdown control and trade-count preservation
insights.summary: Apply a short time stop only to stalled losing positions in non-trending regimes, not to all trades.
insights.suggestedMutation: Track `barsInTrade = ta.barssince(strategy.position_size == 0)`. Add `if strategy.position_size > 0 and rangeRegime and barsInTrade >= 3 and close <= strategy.position_avg_price * 1.002 strategy.close('L')`. Thresholds can be tightened or loosened in one line.

insights.title: Regime-aware exit tightening and trade-count recovery for 120m QQQ strategy
insights.summary: Prefer tapered counter-trend suppression in trend_down over full long-entry bans.
insights.suggestedMutation: In Pine, if regime == trend_down, require setupScore >= highTierThreshold for entry, or require close > fastEMA and ROC(len) > 0 before allowing longs; optionally reduce qty by 50% instead of blocking all entries.

insights.title: Low-complexity regime-aware mutation patterns for drawdown control and trade-count preservation
insights.summary: Use a regime-localized loser exit in range or squeeze conditions instead of globally tightening exits.
insights.suggestedMutation: Define `rangeRegime = math.abs(ta.ema(close, 20) - ta.ema(close, 50)) < ta.atr(14) * 0.3` or `bbWidth = (ta.bb(close,20,2)[1] - ta.bb(close,20,2)[2]) / close; rangeRegime = bbWidth < bbThresh`. Then add `if strategy.position_size > 0 and rangeRegime and close < strategy.position_avg_price and barsSinceEntry >= 2 strategy.close('L')`.

insights.title: Regime-aware exit tightening and trade-count recovery for 120m QQQ strategy
insights.summary: Use regime-specific loser exits only in low-trend states rather than tightening exits globally.
insights.suggestedMutation: In Pine, when regime == range or range_squeeze, replace the base stop with min(baseStop, entryPrice - k1*ATR) and add a close-condition exit if barsSinceEntry >= n1 and maxRunupATR < r1. Leave trend_up exits unchanged.
